risk_notes: sqlite3 CLI tool is referenced without version pinning or installation instructions; relies on system-provided binary.
Cleanup scripts execute destructive operations (DROP TABLE, DELETE FROM, VACUUM) without confirmation or transaction wrapping; accidental execution could cause irreversible data loss.
Scripts disable foreign key constraints (PRAGMA foreign_keys = OFF) during execution, which could mask referential integrity issues if interrupted mid-run.
No backup automation is enforced; README only advises manual backup as a best practice.
